name: Hicklebee's Book Fair
description: The Hicklebee's Book Fair is coming to Los Alamitos this week! Every spring, our PTA is thrilled to host a second book fair to promote summer reading. This year, we're delighted to continue our partnership with our local children's bookstore, Hicklebee's, who will generously provide the books for our fair.

name: Reading Lab Volunteers Needed
description: The Reading Lab is a tutoring program for students who would benefit from extra help with fundamental reading skills. We are looking for volunteers who can come in once per week (Tuesday, Wednesday, or Thursday) from 12:45pm - 2:00pm during the school year. Training for new tutors is provided!! Helping these new & growing readers is super fun and rewarding!

name: Math Kangaroo
description: Thank you to Harini for hosting our very first Math Kangaroo test at Los Alamitos. The event was a wonderful success, and we truly appreciate the time, effort, and care you put into making it such a smooth and positive experience for everyone involved. With 54 students participating, it was inspiring to see our community come together to embrace a global competition that promotes problem-solving and critical thinking in such a fun and engaging way. Results will be available in May, and parents will be able to log in to their child's account to view them.

name: Nowruz (Iranian New Year) Staff Luncheon
description: Thank you to our Iranian community for hosting a wonderful luncheon for the Los Alamitos staff in celebration of the Nowruz. We truly appreciate you sharing your delicious traditional dishes and beautiful culture with us. Wishing everyone a joyful and Happy Nowruz! Nowruz, meaning "new day," marks the Persian New Year and the first day of spring. Celebrated for over 3,000 years, it symbolizes renewal, hope, and new beginnings. Families gather to enjoy special foods, set a traditional "Haft-Seen" table, and spend time with loved ones to welcome the year ahead.

name: PTA Board Positions for 2026-27
description: We are looking for members of our Los Alamitos community to join our PTA Executive Board for 2026-27 school year! If you're interested in getting involved, please email us or connect with any of our current board members. Our board positions include: President, Executive VP, VP of Enrichment, VP of Events and Recognition, VP of Fundraising, VP of Communications, Secretary, Treasurer, Financial Reviewer, and Parliamentarian.

name: Yearbook Lead Volunteer Needed
description: The PTA would like to thank Sogol Jacks for being our yearbook lead for the last several years! She has done such an amazing job!! It's time for someone new to take over for next year. Are you creative? Maybe have an affinity for memory keeping or scrapbooking?! Please email losalamitoselementaryyearbook@gmail.com if you're interested! If we don't get a volunteer, we will have no yearbook!! Thanks in advance for volunteering!
